PHI.text: Became first player in NBA History to reach 16,000 field goals with 13-point performance vs. Detroit on Nov. 4.

Anfernee Simons is the first 76er in franchise history to make at least five three-pointers off the bench in three consecutive games (10/28 vs. IND (6-10 3FG), 10/30 vs. NYK (5-8 3FG), 10/31 vs. CHA (5-9 3FG)).

DET.text: Jalen Duren has the 4th-highest fi eld goal percentage through fi ve career seasons in NBA history (min. 1,000 FGM).

WAS.text: Logged his 39th career 40-point double-double on 11/9 at Detroit, tying Michael Jordan for the seventh-most since 1973-74.
The Wizards broke their all-time record for points in a season opener with 128 against Milwaukee on 10/21/26.
Dybantsa posted 11 points, nine rebounds and four steals on 11/6 at Atlanta, making him the third Wizards rookie since 2000 to record 10+ points, 9+ rebounds and 4+ steals in a game.

Young already ranks among the best assisters in league history and currently ranks among the leaders in total games with at least 10-plus, 20-plus, 30-plus and 40-plus points while dishing out 10-plus assists.
Young holds a career average of 9.74 assists per game, good for the third-highest mark in NBA history among all qualified players.
He is the fastest player in Wizards history to reach 150+ steals and 150+ blocks to start their career.

DAL.text: Washington Jr. surpassed 6,000 career points (6,009) and 2,000 points as a Maverick (2,010), moving into 47th place on Dallas' all-time scoring list (vs. SAC, 11/2/26).
Kyrie Irving recorded 24 points at IND (10/23/26) to surpass Mavericks legend Mark Aguirre (18,458) for 74th place in the NBA's all-time scoring list.
Zaccharie Risacher notched 5 steals in his Mavericks debut, setting a career high and tied Shawn Bradley for the second-most steals in a season opener in Mavs history (6, Brad Davis).

Tied Jalen Brunson, Chris Gatling, Tim Hardaway Jr., Devin Harris, Antawn Jamison and Fat Lever for the eighth-most points off the bench in a season opener in franchise history after notching 17 points (6-8 FG, 4-5 3FG, 1-1 FT).
Cooper Flagg needs 21 assists (379) to reach 400 career assists.
Naji Marshall needs 76 field goals (1,424) to reach 1,500 career field goals made.

MIN.text: Minnesota outscored their first three opponents opponents by 70 points this season, the 10th highest through three games in NBA history.

On Oct. 31, Dosunmu became just the sixth player in the NBA this season to record 25+ points/5+ rebounds/3+ steals while shooting 60%+ from the floor and the 17th player in franchise history to accomplish the feat.

With 15 rebounds against the Jazz on Nov. 8, Gobert scratched his 77th 15+ rebound performance in a Timberwolves uniform (249th career), marking the fourth-most 15+ rebound games in franchise history (Kevin Garnett: 211, Kevin Love: 108, Karl-Anthony Towns: 93).

Minnesota has now made 148 three-pointers on the season, marking the second-most made threes in the NBA this season (Atlanta: 155) and the tied for the second-most made threes through the first nine games of a season in franchise history.

The Wolves held an eight-point lead over the Raptors at halftime on Oct. 25, marking the fifth time Minnesota had led by 8+ points at halftime in each of their first three games of the season and the first time doing so since the 2022-23 season.
The Wolves’ 23-point win against the Raptors on Oct. 25 marked the second-highest margin of victory in a home opener in franchise history (+36, 2016 vs. Memphis).

He is the only player in the NBA this season to have multiple 40+ point games with Oct. 26 game marking the first time in franchise history a player had recorded multiple 40+ point games within the first four games of the season.
He is now tied with D’Angelo Russell for the 16th most 15+ point games in franchise history.
He is the second player to amass those numbers in his first 10 games with the Timberwolves all-time (D’Angelo Russell - 213 points, 43 rebounds, 69 assists).

CHA.text: Miller passed Nic Batum for ninth place on the franchise's all-time leaderboard for 3-pointers made (497) versus Miami (Oct. 24).
Brandon Miller logged his third-straight 30-point game at Detroit (Oct. 28), becoming the first player in the NBA this season to post three-straight 30-point performances.
Brandon Miller became the second-fastest player in NBA history to reach 500 career 3-pointers made (Oct. 26 vs. WAS).
Brandon Miller is 18 3-pointers made away from passing PJ Washington for seventh-most in franchise history.
Hall is 2 rebounds away from 100 career rebounds.
Kon Knueppel is 68 rebounds away from 500 career rebounds.

PHX.text: Booker is one of four players in league history to tally 18,000 points, 3,900 assists and 1,000 three-pointers before turning 30.
